A different kind of conversation

Financial guidance should feel personal, not transactional.

KeriBloom Legacy Group was created for people who want to understand the purpose behind a financial strategy, not simply be handed a product. Kerissa begins with the people, obligations and goals connected to every decision.

Her background in military service, finance and leadership brings structure to the process without removing the warmth and honesty clients need.

Read Kerissa’s Story
What we help clarify

Three priorities. One connected plan.

Protection, retirement and legacy are not separate conversations. Each one affects the people, responsibilities and future you are working to protect.

01 · PROTECT

Family and income protection

Understand how illness, death or a major life event could affect income, housing, debt and the people who depend on you.

02 · PREPARE

Retirement and long-term care

Discuss future income concerns, care needs and the role protection may play in preserving your retirement strategy.

03 · PRESERVE

Legacy and business continuity

Consider beneficiaries, family responsibilities, ownership risks and the resources intended for future generations.
